title: When Fairness Meets Privacy: Exploring Privacy Threats in Fair Binary Classifiers through Membership Inference Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical intersection of privacy attacks and fairness-enhancing interventions in machine learning classifiers (primarily CNNs for computer vision and tabular data). While it includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations' regarding the tension between privacy and fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems.
